title: CIC interrogates Viktor Schauberger for nine months

tellings.quote: According to historian Nick Cook's great book, The Hunt for Zero Point, CIC agents interrogated Shaburgger for nine months, fully aware of his most classified work.

plain: After the war in 1945, agents of the Counter Intelligence Corps, a US Army spy-catching unit, questioned an Austrian inventor named Viktor Schauberger for nine months, knowing all about his most secret work. Michels tells this from the book The Hunt for Zero Point by the historian Nick Cook, in an episode on whether Henry Kissinger oversaw a program to recover crashed UFOs. It matters to him because it suggests the Americans took Schauberger's unusual work very seriously.
